narration.full_text: Hello and welcome to our journey into the fascinating world of trigonometry! Today, we're going to dive into the core concepts of trigonometric ratios. By the end of this lesson, you'll have a solid understanding of what these ratios are and how they relate to right-angled triangles. We'll explore the six fundamental trigonometric ratios and even work through some examples to solidify your understanding. Get ready to unlock a powerful tool in mathematics!
